aleabitoreddit.recent_shift: 近期观点从关注市场波动和杠杆清算，转向强调基本面强劲和供应瓶颈，认为市场回调是过度反应，看好长期结构性增长。
representative_quotes: SK Hynix, $MU , and Samsung have sold out of 2027 capacity for DRAM/HBM. ... Hard to see those memory "oversupply" claims in early-mid 2027 when they're all sold out of capacity already.

Given each hyperscaler has flagged either compute shortages, rising cloud demand + pricing power, or increased spending for chips/networking. My "bottleneck" thesis with many of these upstream semi supply chains is that when trillions in capital flows into things from InP substrates or memory (which were both treated as cheap commodities) or even energy. Lot of these current AI names that were treated as useless before in telecom cycles or even toilet sellers. Gets rerated when their inflection period hits and capex flows into their balance sheets.
I personally think current market conditions are a reflection of liquidity and leverage, not individual fundamentals.
